subject.title: feat(android): pair multiple gateways and switch between them without re-pairing

question: Should maintainers sponsor this Android multi-gateway implementation as the landing path for issue 100700 once it is rebased and proven, or should Android wait for a different staged design?
rationale: The permanent shape affects official mobile UX, credential migration, device-token ownership, notification routing, and session/cache isolation, so automation cannot choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Proceed After Proof
options.body: Keep this PR as the Android candidate, require rebase plus real device proof and security-owner review, then land if the exact head is clean.

options.title: Stage A Narrower Android Slice
options.body: Keep issue 100700 canonical but ask for a smaller Android PR that lands registry, credentials, and UI in separate reviewed steps.

options.title: Pause Android Implementation
options.body: Defer or close this PR if maintainers want the iOS shape to bake before Android adopts the same state model.

recommendation.title: Proceed After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the Android candidate, require rebase plus real device proof and security-owner review, then land if the exact head is clean.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current PR and has the strongest recent cross-platform history on this multi-gateway work.
